messages.text: Can you make a 2d (x/y) projection view of the sensitive hits in the Endcap to see the readout module segmentation?
I’ll inspect the existing endcap hit data and make an x–y view that shows the occupied readout cells. I’ll use the saved samples and keep the deferred Marlin study untouched.

Created the **+z ECAL x–y view**. The layer-14 zoom shows the **5.1 mm readout cells** and the boundary between **modules 13 and 14**.

Also embedded in [PR #118](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/118).
